I’m always happy to hear you! Whether you would like to discuss a possible collaboration, exchange ideas, or simply say hello, feel free to contact me through LinkedIn.

## Statistical consulting

Need statistical input on a research project? I’m happy to consult on:

- Study design and analysis planning
- Data preparation and reproducible workflows
- Regression and mixed-effects models
- Longitudinal and latent trajectory analyses
- Causal inference 
- Interpretation and presentation of results
- Manuscript writing on statistical methods and results 

Support can range from a single consultation to ongoing analytical collaboration. I am particularly interested in health and psychological research, but I am open to other empirical projects as well.

[Contact me on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jasmindoenicke/){.btn .btn-primary}

:::
